> @copilot 改完了没有效果，还是 404 http://localhost:3001/api/v1/ai/agents
> 
> 

The previous fix was incomplete. I found the deeper root cause: the `ObjectKernel.bootstrap()` only injected the in-memory 'metadata' fallback in `validateSystemRequirements()`, which runs **after** all plugin `start()` methods complete. So when `AIServicePlugin.start()` called `ctx.getService('metadata')`, no 'metadata' service existed yet (MetadataPlugin is not in the default config), causing the call to throw and `metadataService` to always be `undefined`.

Fixed in commit `b083c75` by adding `preInjectCoreFallbacks()` to `kernel.ts`, called between Phase 1 (init) and Phase 2 (start). This ensures 'core' service fallbacks like 'metadata' are available before any plugin's `start()` runs. After this fix:
- `AIServicePlugin.start()` successfully gets the metadata service
- Agents (`data_chat`, `metadata_assistant`) get registered
- Agent routes (`GET /api/v1/ai/agents`) get built and mounted
- The AI Chat panel will show all agents in the dropdown
